About this Event

Chai & Chamak: A SASH Ladies' Night ✨Beauty • Wellness • Sisterhood
A little pampering, a little shopping, plenty of chai, and a whole lot of chamak!
Join South Asian Social House (SASH) for Chai & Chamak, a special ladies' night bringing together women from across the DMV for an evening of beauty, wellness, delicious South Asian treats, and great company.
Think of it as a girls' night out with a little bit of everything: discover new beauty and lifestyle brands, enjoy interactive experiences, learn from a dermatologist, indulge in some self-care, and connect with an amazing community of women.
And did we mention the gift bags?

🎁 Luxury Gift Bags Valued at $155 — Included with Every Ticket!We're going all out on the gift bags! Every attendee will take home a curated beauty and wellness gift bag currently valued at $155, featuring luxury, full-size skincare and beauty products.
Forget the usual handful of samples and coupons. We're partnering with premium beauty and wellness brands to put together gift bags filled with beautiful, high-quality products you'll actually love using.
And the best part? We're still adding to them! With more brand partnerships in the works, we're hoping to make these gift bags even more special by December 9.

✨ A Sneak Peek Inside Our Gift Bags: Anokha Skincare!We're excited to feature Anokha Skincare, a luxury skincare brand inspired by South Asian beauty traditions, among our gift bag partners!
Anokha has generously contributed its Blue Clay Clarifying Masque (retail value: $65) and accompanying mask brushes (retail value: $22) — a beautiful skincare duo with a combined retail value of $87!
We're thrilled to include these luxurious skincare treats among the goodies making their way into our gift bags. And this is just a sneak peek! Stay tuned as we reveal more of the brands and products joining C
